target.title: fix(codex): app inventory error diagnostics stay UTF-16 safe
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Codex app inventory refresh diagnostics could serialize a long error message with a dangling UTF-16 surrogate when the redacted message was truncated at the 500-code-unit limit.

The affected workflow is Codex app-server app inventory refresh error reporting: if an `app/list` failure message contains a non-BMP character at the truncation boundary, the serialized diagnostic can contain a broken replacement character instead of a valid truncated message.

## Why This Change Was Made

The app inventory serializer already uses UTF-16-safe truncation for nested serialized error data. This applies the same existing helper to the top-level sanitized error message after HTML-body omission and secret redaction.

This intentionally keeps the existing 500-character limit, redaction patterns, cache behavior, and app-server protocol unchanged.

## User Impact

Developers and operators inspecting Codex app inventory refresh diagnostics now get valid truncated UTF-16 messages, including when long error messages contain emoji or other surrogate-pair characters at the truncation boundary.

## Evidence

- Pre-fix regression proof: the new focused test failed on `origin/main` behavior with the serialized message ending in `�...` instead of a UTF-16-safe `...` truncation.
- Pre-submit checks: `origin/main` still used `redacted.slice(0, MAX_SERIALIZED_ERROR_MESSAGE_LENGTH)` in `sanitizeErrorMessage`; open PRs found by the target file path (#99177 and #102054) did not modify `sanitizeErrorMessage`, `redacted.slice`, `truncateUtf16Safe`, or `MAX_SERIALIZED_ERROR_MESSAGE_LENGTH`.
- Focused regression test:

  ```text
  [test] starting test/vitest/vitest.extension-codex.config.ts
  The `envFile` option is deprecated, please use `envDir: false` instead.

   RUN  v4.1.9 [local path redacted]


   Test Files  1 passed (1)
        Tests  13 passed (13)
     Start at  12:14:46
     Duration  13.43s (transform 6.82s, setup 462ms, import 12.52s, tests 37ms, environment 0ms)

  [test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 24.45s
  ```

- Production-module runtime proof:

  ```text
  {"messageLength":502,"suffix":"...","containsReplacement":false}
  ```

- Committed diff whitespace check:

  ```text
  git diff --check origin/main...HEAD
  Validation result: pass, exit_code=0, 129ms
  ```
